title: Why Blockbuster Couldn't Outrun Netflix
hook: How did 9,000 video stores become just one?
closing: Even giants can vanish fast when habits change, and one small store still rents movies.
question: Have you ever rented from that store?

segments.say: Netflix's mail subscribers nearly tripled, to 12.3 million. Why drive to a store when the movie shows up at home?
Blockbuster once ran 9,000 stores. By 2014, the company owned none of them. The giant had been hollowed out.
By 2018, just two stores were left on Earth, in Bend and Perth. Within a year, only Bend still had one.
